messages:
jamie: Kicking off BlueRidge POC. Requirements: SSO (SAML/IdP), SCIM for user + group provisioning, RBAC mapping to their internal roles, and domain controls (tenant-bound domains). Need: timeline for a demo, any Dedicated pricing delta for enterprise SSO, and a list of blockers. cc @alex @morgan :wave:

alex: Thanks — high level plan: 1) SAML test with Okta/Azure, 2) SCIM v2 provisioning run using a staging connector, 3) RBAC mapping doc + sample API calls, 4) domain ownership TXT for domain binding. Estimate 2 weeks for a simple POC if they provide IdP access and test accounts.

morgan: Security checklist items from their GRC: audit logs retention (12 months), KMS-backed key storage, SAML metadata validation, SCIM over TLS, and SCIM SCIM event auditing. Legal needs a response on data residency — are they ok with US-only?

jamie: They asked for EU data residency option. Also pricing Q: they asked whether SSO/SCIM work on Hosted or requires Dedicated.

devon: Both work on Hosted as first-class features, but Dedicated gives you predictable throughput and in-region hosting which the bank prefers. Pricing: Hosted: standard usage + enterprise support. Dedicated: monthly commit + setup fee. I can pull exact numbers but expect ~2x unit cost for Dedicated and a 60-90 day lead for capacity scheduling.

sasha: For RBAC mapping — we'll need a simple mapping file from SCIM groups to Redwood roles. Example mapping for them to review:

```json
{
  "scimGroupToRedwoodRole": {
    "BR_Admins": "org.admin",
    "BR_Developers": "app.editor",
    "BR_ReadOnly": "app.viewer"
  }
}
```

sasha: We support attribute-based rules too (e.g., claim `department=payments` -> role `payments.processor`).

alex: Domain verification process: we sign a tenant to a verified domain. BlueRidge will need to add a DNS TXT record we provide. Once verified, we lock signups to that domain and enforce email assertion in SAML. Blocker: they require that domain verification can be performed by their security team only (no external emails). That's fine — DNS TXT is the usual path.

morgan: On SAML—confirm support for IDP-initiated and SP-initiated flows. Need to confirm assertion encryption requirement. Also they require Signed AuthnRequests and want recipient/recipient/clock skew checks.

devon: We support both flows. We can accept signed AuthnRequests and will validate signatures. For assertion encryption we currently support encrypted assertions for Dedicated customers with KMS integration; on Hosted we can accept signed assertions but not encrypted assertions unless we enable per-tenant key wrapping (requires enterprise setup).

jamie: So the big blockers for this POC: (1) legal sign-off on EU residency or explicit data processing terms, (2) access to their Okta/Azure test tenant + test user list, (3) decision on Hosted vs Dedicated (pricing + timeline), (4) confirmation of assertion encryption requirement, (5) DNS team availability to add TXT for domain verification.

morgan: I'll take the legal/data residency questions — need to know if they need data physically in EU (we have EU region options for Dedicated/private). I'll draft the security answers by EOD.

alex: To speed SCIM testing, ask them to provide: SCIM base URL, admin token/client creds, sample user JSON, and at least one group. Our SCIM connector supports bulk replace (PUT) and incremental (PATCH). Typical mapping quirks: their groups may include nested groups — we flatten on our side and surface a join membership list. Warn them.

sasha: Also note: SCIM schema differences — Okta sends `urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User` while Azure sometimes wraps attributes under `onpremises`. We can share a small mapping script if they want.

jamie: BlueRidge asked whether SCIM can provision roles directly vs groups. Answered: we map SCIM groups to Redwood roles; if they want direct role assignment we can accept a custom SCIM extension (`x-redwood-role`) — that's doable but requires a short change window.

okta-bot: Automated message: SAML test connector created (conn-7893) in staging. Use metadata URL: https://staging.redwood-inference.com/saml/metadata/conn-7893

devon: I'll hook up the staging connector tomorrow. Quick SAML metadata snippet for them to paste into Okta if needed:

```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://staging.redwood-inference.com/saml/metadata/conn-7893\">\n  <SPSSODescriptor>\n    <AssertionConsumerService Binding=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST\" Location=\"https://staging.redwood-inference.com/saml/acs\"/>\n  </SPSSODescriptor>\n</EntityDescriptor>
```

jamie: Timeline ask from BlueRidge: demo next Wednesday, end-to-end POC in 3 weeks. Are we confident?

devon: If they provide IdP creds and a test domain this week, demo next Wed (partial: SAML + basic SCIM) is doable. Full RBAC mapping and domain lock demo in 3 weeks is realistic.

morgan: Legal will need the DPIA / data processing addendum before Dedicated commit. I'll attach a template and flag any major exceptions.

alex: Action items: jamie -> get IdP test creds + sample users + domain contact; morgan -> draft legal/security responses; devon -> stand up staging SAML connector and SCIM endpoint; sasha -> prepare RBAC mapping examples and mapping script.

jamie: I'll ping BlueRidge now and ask for creds + confirm EU residency requirement. Will update thread when they reply. :rocket:
